title: Launch vericash app and pass onboarding to reach the home screen
preconditions: vericash app is installed on the device and device is unlocked
steps: On the onboarding screen, tap the 'Next' button at approximate coordinates (350, 1050)
On the Server URL screen, tap the 'Go To Home' button at approximate coordinates (367, 771)
Verify the app reached a screen past the Server URL page
expected_result: The app successfully passes onboarding and the Server URL screen and reaches the next screen
